name: Welsh Ornithological Society Project Grants
summary: Small grants for projects that benefit birds in Wales, with priority for red and amber listed species. Paid in two halves, with two application rounds a year.

amount.note: Up to £1,000 stated for 2025; more in exceptional circumstances

reporting: Half of the grant is paid on receipt of a report on the work.

calls.label: Two rounds a year
calls.recurring: Applications due 30 June and 31 December each year
